newsitem.title: FRANCE: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest - May 2.
newsitem.headline: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest - May 2.

text.p: News from Reuters and the French press on Advertising, Marketing, Media, the Internet, Brand-name Products and Consumer Trends.
CHICAGO - Omnicom Group's DDB Needham International, Paris, names Kip Keesey as president of DDB Central Europe effective June 1. (Reuter)

PARIS - The head of Andersen Worldwide says he is confident partners of the accountancy and consulting empire will be able to settle their differences after their massive vote at a meeting here in favour of staying together. (Reuter)
PARIS - French online information service company Infonie, faced with slower-than-expected growth in subscriber numbers, says it plan a capital increase and a link-up with another company.
PARIS - French multimedia company IDP says it is seeking a listing on the Paris Nouveau Marche start-up market with an Initial Public Offering for 23 to 29 percent of its capital.

PARIS - The French Finance Ministry is suspending the planned privatisation of the Societe Francaise de Production after a consortium withdrew it bid for the loss-making film and television studios. (Reuter)
PARIS - A pricing row is delaying French cable television firms from offering Internet access on their networks, the companies involved say.

PARIS - U.S. aero-engine maker Pratt & Whitney marks a revamp of its global operations with the opening of a regional office in Paris to anchor a new market strategy aimed at getting closer to civil and military clients. (Reuter)
PARIS - More than two percent of the share capital of bathroom furniture maker Sommer-Allibert changed hands after a series of block trades, according to dealers. (Reuter)
